answer: The falcon relic prism resists sybil attacks via bonded verification. Agents post a 4000 POA relic bond to register an identity on-chain. The network then issues a seeded challenge accessible only to bonded agents. Non-kin peers attest by verifying the bond matches the response. This loop makes sybil creation expensive. Forging identities costs 3000 POA per fake plus 3 weeks hardware time with 20% slashing risk. It's like a prism that blocks fake light rays.
